prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     If object is close, take it, then move it if it's heavy; If not visible, scan for it; else approach and process.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    />  <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />  <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    />     <Action ID = MoveObject    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = ApproachObject    />  <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    />  <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />     <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> </Sequence>"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
				DO MoveObject
		END
	END
